messages:
alicia: FYI found a bad RBAC grant in the onprem tenant-vault cluster. serviceaccount 'metrics-collector' bound to cluster-admin. opening thread to coordinate rollback + KMS scope check.

dino: omg. can you paste the binding snippet and which deployment created it?

alicia: snippet from kube-apiserver audit attached: 
```json
{\n  \"kind\": \"ClusterRoleBinding\",\n  \"metadata\": {\"name\": \"metrics-collector-admin\"},\n  \"subjects\": [{\"kind\": \"ServiceAccount\", \"name\": \"metrics-collector\", \"namespace\": \"tenant-vault\"}],\n  \"roleRef\": {\"kind\": \"ClusterRole\", \"name\": \"cluster-admin\"}\n}
```

emma: oncall. I'll revoke the binding and create a scoped Role. also need to know if the node-agent used the KMS key for metrics encryption. tagging @ops-oncall to gate key rotation.

ops-oncall: copying steps I'll run:
- kubectl delete clusterrolebinding metrics-collector-admin
- create Role 'metrics-read' & RoleBinding to 'metrics-collector-scoped'
- patch DaemonSet to use new SA
- apply NetworkPolicy to restrict egress to KMS + internal metrics endpoint
- rotate KMS key and update IAM on new key
- bump audit retention for tenant-vault to 72h

sec-bot: Alert: rbac-excessive-privs detected for serviceaccount tenant-vault:metrics-collector at 1719554300. Recommended: revoke binding and rotate credentials.

alicia: NetworkPolicy draft from infra-eng to limit agent egress: 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: metrics-agent-egress-lock
  namespace: tenant-vault
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: metrics-agent
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.4.0.0/24   # internal metrics collector
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          redwood-infra: kms
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

infra-eng: applied NP, confirmed pods cannot egress to internet except allowed CIDRs.

emma: SIEM shows kms:Decrypt from pod IP 10.4.2.9 three times in last 20m. we should rotate that key ASAP.

ops-oncall: scheduling key rotation in 5m. plan: create new key, update agent to use new key, re-encrypt backlog, then revoke decrypt on old key. will stream updates.

alicia: also run `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:tenant-vault:metrics-collector create clusterrolebinding` from a control pod to validate perms gone.

dino: digging into deploy-helper run logs. looks like deploy-helper v2.3 had a template that allowed cluster-admin if team flag set to true. adding a hard deny in templates.

emma: good. follow-ups for postmortem:
- cause: permissive deploy-helper template used in onprem pipeline
- impact: tenant-vault only; no confirmed exfil so far
- mitigations: RBAC rollback, NetworkPolicy, KMS rotation, increased audit retention
- action items: add Gatekeeper constraint to block ClusterRoleBinding creations in onprem except approved list; add pre-apply linter that fails on cluster-admin in manifests; require 2nd approver for cluster-admin-related changes; rotate any long-lived tokens.

infra-eng: I'll prototype a Gatekeeper rego rule and schedule a canary in staging. can also add periodic scan that lists serviceaccounts with cluster-admin bindings and posts to #eng-security daily.

ops-oncall: rotation started. new key created, updating agent config map to reference new key ARN, rolling update the DS. temporarily denied decrypt on old key while backlog re-encrypts.

emma: monitoring: SIEM shows decrypt attempts for old key failing now. no new suspicious outbound connections.

alicia: please revoke any Vault tokens issued to metrics-collector and rotate secrets used by the agent. once done we can close incident and file postmortem.

dino: will add template fixes to deploy-helper repo and open PR for gating.

ops-oncall: done with actions. all checks green, audit retention bumped. scheduling a tabletop run next week to exercise this flow.

emma: leaving follow-up ticket: SECURITY-1247 (hardening onprem RBAC + Gatekeeper + deploy-helper lint)

alicia: thanks team. closing thread after final verification pass. :lock:
